title: The Influence of Mattress Stiffness on Spinal Curvature and Intervertebral Disc Stress—An Experimental and Computational Study

license.evidence: Retained article Copyright and License information

specimen_conditions.code_to_curve_mapping: Listed in same sequence as SM/MM/HM, but not separately assigned; keep curve IDs as authoritative
specimen_conditions.unknown_field_basis: Not specified in inspected article methods; do not invent

digitization.method: Manual line-center pixel picks on retained Figure1b, linear axes; origin is an explicit zero-load boundary anchor
digitization.uncertainty_scope: Screening estimates, not statistical confidence bounds; axis placement, JPEG blur and medium/pillow overlap add uncertainty

engineering_law_candidate.type: Nonnegative monotone piecewise-linear compression stress versus positive compression strain
engineering_law_candidate.thickness_basis: Specific study mattress geometry, not optimized to simulation
engineering_law_candidate.nominal_stress_interpretation: Assume displayed stress is nominal engineering stress; original measure definition unreported; verify before 3D calibration
engineering_law_candidate.extrapolation: forbidden beyond digitized domain; reject candidate, do not silently clip force
engineering_law_candidate.skin_coupling: Equal pressure in series, delta_total=delta_skin+delta_bed; preserve skin-specific strain bound
engineering_law_candidate.inertia: External supported bed; no added human inertial mass

unresolved.skin_bed_friction: not calibrated; article0.6 is pillow-to-mattress interface and cannot be transferred
unresolved.lateral_shear_and_column_coupling: Local-column reduction unvalidated against full mattress indentation
unresolved.bottoming_out: 200mm finite thickness known; densification/bottom contact beyond retained curve domain unavailable

calibration_scope: Specific paper foam curves only, digitized approximation; not a patient-specific or universal mattress calibration
